title: Entropy on regular sets and periodic-orbit growth for singular flows
summary: We study entropy and periodic-orbit growth for flows on metric spaces. First, we prove that the finite topological entropy of a flow on a compact metric space is completely carried by compact subsets of its regular set. Next, we establish a Bowen--Walters inequality for geometrically separating flows on possibly noncompact metric spaces, under uniform control at time zero and dynamical isolation at infinity.
